name: team-charter
notes: repoMode workspace (default) means the team branches, codes and merges directly in the person's own repository under the office charter's repoRoot, so the branches show up where they already work; it never resets that checkout and refuses to start when the tree is dirty or off main. repoMode clone isolates the work in a clone under the team's home instead. service and goal ship as REPLACE ME: provision fills the service from the install namespace; the product owner asks for the team goal first unless the product office allocated a direction. repo is the workspace repository (core, agentic-nets, ci) and repoDir the service's directory in it; scopePaths (optional) narrows what the coder may touch. Empty coder fields inherit the product office's charter.
